title: Stir CE page current user
description: The current_user object on Lupus CE page responses. lupus_decoupled_ce_api produces id, name and roles; stir_account adds capabilities.

admin_dashboard_url.description: URL of Drupal's dashboard, sent only when the account may open it.

capabilities.description: Frontend capabilities decided by Drupal permissions. Keys are camelCase booleans.
